title: Code Mode: Cloudflare's faster way to use MCP tools
intro: Instead of calling tools one at a time, the AI writes one small program that does the whole job, and it runs in a locked sandbox.
reel: From the reel: Your AI agent is using MCP tools the slow way

tools.name: Code Mode: the better way to use MCP
tools.what: The idea: turn MCP tools into a code API and let the AI write code against it, because models have seen far more real code than tool calls.

tools.name: Give agents an entire API in 1,000 tokens
tools.what: Cloudflare's API has over 2,500 endpoints. With Code Mode their MCP server covers all of it in around 1,000 tokens, instead of over a million.

tools.name: Code Mode SDK
tools.what: The code, if you want to try it in your own agent.

note: Fewer round trips, smaller prompts. Worth watching.
